assumptions.choice: Entry bar price is measured as the close price of the bar on which the initial buy order completes execution.
assumptions.reason: The specification states initial_investment = 400 * entry_price (close on the entry bar).

assumptions.choice: Threshold multiplier n starts at 1 and increments by 1 sequentially upon reaching each threshold level.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly instructs to move to threshold_{n+1} following a sale at threshold_n.
